words.text: Real units «mm/cm/in/pt», true DPI, bleed and crop marks.
A label printer or a print shop gets exactly what it needs.

The core app is a static deployment with no server-side processing and no database; the two optional server components «the AI-agent endpoint and identity enrolment - see Server Surface» can be omitted entirely.
Operate entirely offline, behind your firewall, with your own access policies.
